summary.tldr: Authorizes $8.58 billion for federal public service spending in 2025-26.
what_it_does: Authorizes $8,580,271,678 to be paid from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for federal public service expenses in 2025-26 that are not otherwise provided for.
Makes the appropriation effective on Royal Assent.
summary.background: This is an appropriation bill for the financial year ending March 31, 2026.
